The '''Experimental V-wing''' was an experimental model of the [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighter]],<ref name="DB" /> which served the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Episode III" /> This model was equipped with a compact [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of limited capacity. A number of these fighters were rumored to belong to an elite [[Color|crimson]]-clad [[Unidentified pilot brigade|pilot brigade]] that reported directly to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="DB" />

Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], three Experimental V-wings escorted the self-appointed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]] during his voyage from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and again on the return trip, culminating at the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]].<ref name="Episode III" /><ref name="ROTS:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
